text:
Riley: Deploy-bot blocked the canary. CI artifact verification failed: runner-cache returned a different digest than registry. We need an immediate decision: pin to previous canary or trigger a cache-busted rebuild + verified upload?

Deploy-bot: promotion-check failed for image redwood/ingest@sha256:9a7d
expected: sha256:9a7d
observed-in-cache (runner-cache-11): sha256:0ff1ce
action: promotion blocked

Nina: Runner logs show runner-cache-11 served a stale blob from yesterdays failed push. We queued a purge at 03:10 UTC but it might not have completed for that shard.

Carlos: For low blast changes I'd rather pin to last good canary sha256:8b3c and move on. Change window is short and customers are watching. Rebuild tonight with explicit CACHE_KEY=none and upload to a temp tag, verify then promote.

Helen: Pin+manual promote seems safest. If we attempt rebuild now and the cache still serves stale blobs we waste time and possibly miss the window. Who can do the manual promote?

ops-bot: registry-eu2 is reporting increased 5xx rate 03:07-03:12 UTC. Purge job for runner-cache-11 started 03:12 UTC, ETA 6m. Filing INC-2026-09.

Marco: I can do the promote and watch the smoke run. Command I'll run: /deploybot promote --image sha256:8b3c --env canary --meta "pin-checksum-drift"
I'll abort if >1% error-rate or latency >200ms p95.

Riley: Good. Nina please attach the purge job to the incident and confirm runner-cache-11 completion. Also open a rebuild PR with --cache-bust and a verification step that downloads and checksum-verifies from registry before any promote.

Nina: Opening PR now. CI snippet I will add:
```
jobs:
  build-and-upload:
    runs-on: runner-cache-11
    steps:
      - run: ./ci/build-image --tag=canary-rebuild --cache-bust
      - run: ./ci/upload --atomic --verify-sha256
  verify:
    needs: build-and-upload
    steps:
      - run: ./ci/pull-and-check --image=canary-rebuild --expected-sha256=9a7d
```

Deploy-bot: Manual promote command received from Marco. Status: queued -> promoting -> smoke-run started.

Marco: Smoke at +5m: error-rate 0.3%, latency steady. Watching full 10m. Added temporary alert set: canary_error_rate > 0.8% for 10m.

ops-bot: purge job for runner-cache-11 completed 03:19 UTC and attached to INC-2026-09. Cache entry removed.

Riley: Great. Action items: Marco promote+watch, Nina PR + rebuild with verify, Carlos coordinate overnight rebuild promotion if staging verifies, Helen update release notes draft with line: "Canary pinned to previous image due to checksum drift; rebuild scheduled and cache purge perfomed (INC-2026-09)." Reopen if smoke fails.

Deploy-bot: smoke-run passed. Canary promoted to sha256:8b3c. Promotion complete.

Marco: Closing watch. No post-promote spikes. Leaving the thread open until rebuild verified.
